title: intrinsic width chip fix
description:
The Library filter chip stacked its label twice on device (E5, then
again on 2026-11-12 on the build that shipped the first guard 973d58f:
Turkish 'Sıkıştırılmış' as 'Sıkış/tırıl/mış'). The first fix pinned the
label Text's own flags (maxLines=1, softWrap=false, Visible) — single-
line by construction in the foundation 1.7.0 sources, yet the device
still stacked it. The chip must not trust the text layer at all.

New approach, measured and pinned:
- Measure the label's intrinsic single-line width with rememberTextMeas-
  urer, same style (labelLarge), resolver and density the chip's Text
  uses, so the measurements agree exactly. The measured string IS the
  displayed string.
- Pin the label Text with requiredWidth(measured) — enforceIncoming=
  false, so the paragraph receives min=max=its own intrinsic width
  whatever constraints reach it; no spare width to wrap into.
- Pin the whole F
changed: fix: chips measure at intrinsic single-line width
